During interactions with a robot, its onboard state information may be unavailable due to privacy, ownership, or communication constraints. Meanwhile, online and AI-generated robot videos provide rich sources of data but typically lack corresponding joint configurations, limiting their direct use in robot learning. To address these issues, we present HumanoidPose, a new framework that treats vision as proprioception to recover full-body joint configurations in world space from video alone. Specifically, we combine pretrained human-pose features with robot kinematics in a unified model that predicts each embodiment's joint configurations. We retarget human motions to sixteen different humanoid embodiments, enabling scalable learning entirely from synthetic data. To improve real-world generalization, we further leverage unlabeled online videos through self-training to develop a 2D robot-pose detector. In our evaluation, HumanoidPose improves joint-angle and joint-position accuracy over the evaluated baselines and reduces joint-angle error by 18-32% relative to the best-performing baseline on each of the three real humanoid platforms. We further show improved global localization and generalization to unseen embodiments. HumanoidPose enables visual understanding of other robots during interaction and extraction of robot motion from online and generated videos.
2610.25288.tldr_en: This work presents HumanoidPose, a new framework that treats vision as proprioception to recover full-body joint configurations in world space from video alone and enables visual understanding of other robots during interaction and extraction of robot motion from online and generated videos.
2610.25288.hf_summary_en: HumanoidPose recovers full-body humanoid robot joint configurations from video by combining human-pose features with robot kinematics and self-training on unlabeled videos.

llm.title_ja: 感覚としての視覚：動画からのヒューマノイドロボット姿勢推定
llm.tldr_ja: 視覚を固有受容感覚として扱い、動画のみからワールド座標系における全身の関節設定を復元する新しいフレームワーク「HumanoidPose」を提案し、多様なヒューマノイドロボットの姿勢推定精度を向上させる。
llm.problem: ロボットとのインタラクション中、プライバシー、所有権、通信の制約によりオンボードのステータス情報が利用できない場合があり、オンラインのロボット動画は関節設定を欠くためロボット学習への直接的な利用が制限される。
llm.method: 事前学習済みの人間の姿勢特徴とロボットの運動学を統合したモデルにより、動画から各エンボディメントの関節設定を予測し、合成データや自己訓練を通じた2Dロボット姿勢検出器を活用する。
llm.result: ベースラインと比較して関節角度および関節位置の精度が向上し、3つの実世界ヒューマノイドプラットフォームにおいて最良のベースラインに対して関節角度誤差を18〜32%削減した。
keywords_ja: ヒューマノイドロボット

2610.25287.title: The Bitter Lesson Comes to Robotics
2610.25287.abstract: General purpose multimodal language models (LMs) are increasingly capable of directly controlling robotic arms (e.g., by commanding end effector poses) to manipulate their environment. Tracking the development of these capabilities is important for understanding their potential benefits, such as improving industrial automation, and risks, such as enabling malicious users to produce dangerous chemical or biological agents. To this end, we investigate the ability of frontier multimodal LMs to directly control physical robotic arms. We evaluate nine models at multiple reasoning-effort and service-tier settings on six manipulation tasks taken from the RoboDojo benchmark. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic comparison of a broad range of frontier LMs across a common suite of manipulation tasks on physical hardware. We find that current frontier models can directly control real robotic arms to perform a variety of manipulation tasks but are not yet precise or efficient enough to complete them within a practical action budget. However, these capabilities are improving rapidly: performance increases on our benchmark between July and October 2026 (inclusive) correspond to a performance doubling time of 53.9 days, while the best recorded execution rate increased by a factor of 4.4 and the lowest recorded execution cost fell by a factor of 6.2. These trends raise the possibility that the Bitter Lesson is coming to robotics; the capabilities of embodied general purpose LMs may one day be comparable to those of more specialized models.
2610.25287.comment: Submitted to the Workshop on The Action Gap (TAG) at CoRL 2026, updated with Gemini Flash 3.6 and Gemini 4 Argon
2610.25287.tldr_en: It is found that current frontier models can directly control real robotic arms to perform a variety of manipulation tasks but are not yet precise or efficient enough to complete them within a practical action budget.

llm.title_ja: 苦い教訓がロボット工学にやってくる
llm.tldr_ja: 最先端の汎用マルチモーダル言語モデルが物理的なロボットアームを直接制御して様々なマニピュレーションタスクを実行できることを検証し、その性能の急激な向上傾向を示した。
llm.problem: 汎用マルチモーダル言語モデルによるロボットアームの直接制御能力やその限界、および実用的なアクション予算内でタスクを完了させるための精度・効率に関する検証が求められている。
llm.result: 現在の最先端モデルは実機のロボットアームを直接制御して多様なタスクを実行できるが、実用的なアクション予算内で完了させるにはまだ精度や効率が不十分であることを示した。

2610.25261.title: GOFusion: Real-Time Gaussian-Occupancy Submap Fusion for Fisher-Informed Autonomous Robot Navigation
2610.25261.abstract: In this letter, we present GOFusion, a real-time visual mapping system for autonomous robot navigation that anchors Gaussian primitives to local occupancy maps, providing both spatial awareness for path planning and high-fidelity appearance that enables information-driven robot navigation. GOFusion builds 3D Gaussian maps from pose estimates and local occupancy maps obtained via visual-inertial SLAM and enables pose corrections to maintain both geometric and visual consistency. Furthermore, it restricts the 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization to active submaps to bound GPU memory usage. Building on the appearance-rich Gaussian map, we introduce a rasterizer-integrated Fisher approximation that quantifies per-primitive sensitivity online, serving as an information-driven heuristic for Gaussian pruning and next-best-view planning. We evaluate GOFusion on public datasets and in real-world drone flights. It not only outperforms several baselines in mapping quality, but also achieves real-time, high-fidelity and uncertainty-aware mapping at scale. Finally, we demonstrate fully autonomous drone exploration for Gaussian map refinement using the proposed Fisher-informed heuristic. Code is available at https://github.com/Bennnoo/GOFusion. We provide a supplementary video demonstration at https://youtu.be/pLQKbxQvb6I.
2610.25261.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Paper under review
2610.25261.tldr_en: A rasterizer-integrated Fisher approximation that quantifies per-primitive sensitivity online is introduced, serving as an information-driven heuristic for Gaussian pruning and next-best-view planning and achieves real-time, high-fidelity and uncertainty-aware mapping at scale.

llm.title_ja: GOFusion: フィッシャー情報に基づく自律ロボットナビゲーションのためのリアルタイムGaussian-Occupancyサブマップ融合
llm.tldr_ja: ガウスプリミティブを局所占有マップにアンカーし、パス計画のための空間認識と情報駆動型ロボットナビゲーションを可能にするリアルタイム視覚マッピングシステム「GOFusion」を提案する。
llm.problem: 自律ロボットのナビゲーションにおいて、経路計画に必要な空間認識と、情報駆動型の次視点計画を両立させるリアルタイムの高精度3Dマッピングが求められている。
llm.method: 視覚慣性SLAMで得られたポーズ推定と局所占有マップから3Dガウス地図を構築し、アクティブなサブマップに最適化を制限するとともに、オンラインでのプリミティブ感度を定量化するラスタライザー統合フィッシャー近似を導入する。
llm.result: 公開データセットおよび実機ドローン飛行実験において、マッピング品質で複数のベースラインを上回り、リアルタイムで高精度かつ不確実性を考慮した大規模マッピングを実現した。

2610.26962.title: DexGraspFlow: Topology-Aware SE(3) Flow Matching for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
2610.26962.abstract: Differences in hand geometry, joint parameterization, and kinematic topology pose challenges for cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation. However, spatial relations among links alone are insufficient to fully capture the hand's kinematic topology. We propose DexGraspFlow, a conditional link-level $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ flow-matching framework integrating geometric relations and kinematic topology. The framework encodes local object geometry, link geometry, and current poses. A dual-stream DiT models link--link coordination and link--object interaction, while attention biases derived from kinematic-tree distances provide explicit structural information for modeling evolving geometric interactions. The model jointly learns translational and rotational velocity fields, integrates them to generate link poses, and recovers joint configurations through inverse kinematics. Additionally, inference-time palm-orientation guidance enables controllable grasp generation without retraining. Across three robotic hands and 30 object--hand pairs, DexGraspFlow achieves a 95.33\% average simulation success rate, with an average generation latency, including inverse kinematics, approximately 49\% lower than that of a state-of-the-art baseline. Further experiments demonstrate zero-shot adaptability to seven finger-removal variants and palm-orientation control. A model trained on demonstrations for the deployed hand achieves a 91\% success rate over 100 real-robot grasping trials, supporting the framework's applicability to physical grasp execution.
2610.26962.tldr_en: DexGraspFlow is proposed, a conditional link-level flow-matching framework integrating geometric relations and kinematic topology that encodes local object geometry, link geometry, and current poses and jointly learns translational and rotational velocity fields, integrates them to generate link poses, and recovers joint configurations through inverse kinematics.

llm.title_ja: DexGraspFlow: クロスエンボディメント器用把持生成のためのトポロジーを考慮したSE(3)フローマッチング
llm.tldr_ja: 局所的な物体の幾何学形状、リンク形状、現在のポーズをエンコードし、幾何学的関係と運動学的トポロジーを統合する条件付きリンクレベルSE(3)フローマッチングフレームワーク「DexGraspFlow」を提案する。
llm.problem: 手の形状、関節のパラメータ化、運動学的トポロジーの違いが、クロスエンボディメントの器用な把持生成において課題となっている。
llm.method: 局所的な物体形状、リンク形状、現在のポーズをエンコードし、運動学的ツリー距離から得られるアテンションバイアスを用いてリンク間の協調とリンク・物体間の相互作用をモデル化するデュアルストリームDiTを提案する。
llm.result: 3つのロボットハンドと30の物体・ハンドペアにおいて平均シミュレーション成功率95.33%を達成し、逆運動学を含む生成レイテンシを最先端ベースラインより約49%削減した。
keywords_ja: クロスエンボディメント

2610.25225.title: AI-Enhanced Radiation Classification in ROS
2610.25225.abstract: This study presents the development of two Robot Operating System (ROS) nodes with a primary focus on differentiating seven radioactive isotopes. The first node, referred to as the model training node, uses a Gradient Boosting classifier to identify and classify these isotopes. The classifier achieved a reported overall accuracy of 95\% on the held-out test dataset. The second node, known as the prediction node, provides classification results when users input data in CSV format. For the practical demonstration, the C12137 radiation detector module was mounted on the Jackal UGV, and an operator approached different radiation sources to collect data. To support future dataset expansion, we also developed a method for converting gamma-spectrum graph images into CSV files. In a separate robotic evaluation across three source locations, 30 of 42 trials were correctly classified (71.43\%). Am-241, Co-60, Cs-137, Na-22, and Ti-44 were correctly classified in all six trials each, whereas Ba-133 and Eu-152 were incorrectly classified in all six trials each. These results show lower accuracy in robotic trials than in the held-out test set.

llm.title_ja: ROSにおけるAIを強化した放射線分類
llm.tldr_ja: 勾配ブースティング分類器を用いて7つの放射性同位体を識別・分類する2つのROSノードを開発し、Jackal UGVに搭載した放射線検出器を用いた実機評価を行った。
llm.problem: ロボットを活用した環境において、複数の放射性同位体を効率的かつ正確に識別・分類する必要がある。
llm.method: ホールドアウトテストデータセットに対して勾配ブースティング分類器を用いたモデル訓練ノードと、CSV形式のデータから分類結果を出力する予測ノードの2つのROSノードを開発した。
llm.result: テストデータセット全体で95%の精度を達成した一方、実ロボットを用いた3つのソース位置での評価では42回の試行中30回（71.43%）が正しく分類された。

2610.25223.title: Map2Vid: Embodied Navigation Video Generation with Human-Friendly Motion Control
2610.25223.abstract: Controllable video generation has recently achieved impressive visual quality, yet existing control paradigms remain poorly suited to embodied navigation. Text prompts are spatially ambiguous, while camera-trajectory control relies on low-level motion specifications that are unintuitive for human users and difficult to manipulate. In this work, we introduce Map2Vid, a novel task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV-map-to-video synthesis problem, together with a large-scale benchmark for systematic evaluation. By using BEV maps, which provide a visual representation of global scene layout and intended navigation routes, Map2Vid enables human-friendly navigation video generation. To support this task, we construct a dedicated dataset with over 100K navigation sequences across 61 indoor scenes, each paired with egocentric videos, BEV maps, camera trajectories and language instructions. We further develop a unified framework that integrates multiple control signals, together with a curriculum training strategy that progressively weakens non-map inputs, enabling flexible inference under both full conditioning and map-only input. Extensive experiments across multiple foundation generation models demonstrate that controllable navigation video generation via BEV map is a viable and promising direction.
2610.25223.tldr_en: A novel task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV-map-to-video synthesis problem, together with a large-scale benchmark for systematic evaluation, and develops a unified framework that integrates multiple control signals, together with a curriculum training strategy that progressively weakens non-map inputs.

llm.title_ja: Map2Vid: 人間フレンドリーなモーション制御を備えた体現型ナビゲーション動画生成
llm.tldr_ja: 体現型ナビゲーション動画生成をBEVマップから動画への合成問題として再定義し、多様な制御信号を統合する統一フレームワークとカリキュラム学習戦略を開発する。
llm.problem: 既存の制御パラダイムは体現型ナビゲーションに適しておらず、テキストプロンプトは空間的に曖昧であり、カメラ軌跡の制御は直感的でなく操作が難しい。
llm.method: 61の屋内シーンにわたる10万以上のナビゲーションシーケンスを持つデータセットを構築し、BEVマップやカメラ軌跡などの複数の制御信号を統合する統一フレームワークを開発した。
llm.result: 複数の基盤生成モデルを用いた広範な実験により、BEVマップを介した制御可能なナビゲーション動画生成が実行可能かつ有望な方向性であることが示された。

2610.25208.title: BrandEval: A Two-Track Multi-Agent Benchmark for Risk-Sensitive LLM Crisis Communication
2610.25208.abstract: Evaluating LLMs for crisis communication requires more than judging isolated responses, because public feedback and competitor actions can reshape trust over time. Existing benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, offering limited evidence about long-horizon risk-sensitive communication. We introduce \textbf{BrandEval}, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents. BrandEval-Static evaluates stakeholder-aware strategic analysis, while BrandEval-Dynamic stress-tests response policies in \textbf{BrandPolis}, a controlled multi-agent sandbox with consumer feedback, competitor responses, and trust-risk trajectories. We also construct \textbf{BrandSRD}, a Chinese crisis-response dataset, and instantiate a reference Strategic Agent using \textbf{Strategic Rationale (SR)}. Across proprietary and open-source models, we find that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete: it aligns with some end-state outcomes but does not reliably predict volatility and delayed recovery; dynamic stress tests further expose tail-risk failures under manipulative or weakly grounded policies. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/BrandEval.
2610.25208.tldr_en: BrandEval is introduced, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents, and it is found that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete.
2610.25208.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

llm.title_ja: BrandEval: リスク感受性LLM危機的コミュニケーションのための2トラックマルチエージェントベンチマーク
llm.tldr_ja: 製品関連のインシデントに対する公開ブランドの対応に焦点を当てた製品危機コミュニケーションのための2トラックベンチマーク「BrandEval」を導入し、静的な戦略的品質だけではボラティリティや遅延回復を信頼性高く予測できないことを明らかにした。
llm.problem: LLMの危機的コミュニケーション能力の評価において、既存のベンチマークは静的かつ単一ターンであり、長期的なリスク感受性コミュニケーションに関する証拠が限られている。
llm.method: ステークホルダーを意識した戦略的分析を評価するBrandEval-Staticと、制御されたマルチエージェントサンドボックスで応答ポリシーをストレステストするBrandEval-Dynamicの2トラックベンチマークを構築した。
llm.result: 静的な戦略的品質は参考になるが不完全であり、動的なストレステストにより操作的または弱く根拠づけられたポリシーの下でのテールリスク障害が露わになった。

2610.25201.title: RAIL-5G: A Challenging Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for AI-Based 5G Indoor Localization
2610.25201.abstract: Reliable radio-based indoor localization is essential for industrial automation, yet existing methods are often evaluated in environments that do not fully reflect the severe multipath and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) conditions encountered in real deployments. This limits our understanding of how AI, i.e., modern geometric, unsupervised, and semi-supervised localization methods generalize to industrial 5G settings. We present RAIL-5G, a public real-world 5G NR channel impulse response (CIR) benchmark recorded in an operational railway maintenance facility. RAIL-5G covers an 811m$^2$ indoor area with eight distributed radio units, robot-mounted user equipment (UE) trajectories, high-accuracy iGPS reference positions, and severe metal-induced multipath caused by train compartments and maintenance infrastructure. We benchmark geometric time-difference of arrival (TDoA), supervised fingerprinting, unsupervised channel charting, and self-supervised wireless pretraining methods. Our results highlight the difficulty of RAIL-5G: on the full dataset, TDoA reaches 7.02m mean average error (MAE), the best unsupervised method reaches 2.46m, and supervised fingerprinting achieves 0.52m. Self-supervised pretraining reduces the labeling effort by up to one order of magnitude, but the remaining gap to supervised learning shows that robust AI-based localization under severe multipath remains an open challenge. The dataset and code are available at https://iis.fraunhofer.de/rail-5g.
2610.25201.comment: To be published in the proceedings of the 16th International Conference on Indoor Positioning and Indoor Navigation (IPIN)

llm.title_ja: RAIL-5G: AIに基づく5G屋内ローカライゼーションのための挑戦的な実世界データセットとベンチマーク
llm.tldr_ja: 実世界の運行中の鉄道保守施設で記録された5G NRチャネルインパルス応答ベンチマーク「RAIL-5G」を提案し、幾何学的手法や教師あり・教師なし測位手法の性能を評価した。
llm.problem: 既存の手法は、実際の展開で遭遇する深刻なマルチパスや非見通し外（NLOS）条件を十分に反映していない環境で評価されており、産業用5G環境におけるAIの汎化性能の理解が制限されている。
llm.method: 鉄道保守施設において8台の分散型無線ユニット、ロボット搭載型ユーザ機器の軌跡、高精度iGPS参照位置を含む5G NRチャネルインパルス応答データセットを構築し、様々な測位手法をベンチマークした。
llm.result: TDoAは7.02mの平均絶対誤差を示し、最良の教師なし手法は2.46m、教師ありフィンガープリンティングは0.52mを達成し、深刻なマルチパス下での堅牢なAI測位が依然として課題であることが示された。

2610.25130.title: Structure over Reasoning: Unified Zero-Shot Navigation with a Small Vision-Language Model
2610.25130.abstract: Vision-language navigation is moving into photorealistic, physically simulated scenes, where the leading zero-shot agents put a vision-language model in the control loop to choose every move and stop. Robots favour small models, whose abilities are uneven: Qwen3-VL-4B can judge whether a single view looks like the goal, but its route reasoning is at chance, its distance estimates nearly constant, its stop votes unreliable. Our agent therefore asks it two perceptual questions per step, which direction looks like the goal and whether the view justifies stopping, plus one gated frontier query on route-bearing instructions, and treats the answers as evidence, not actions: a route-blind semantic field over a bird's-eye map accumulates the directional scores through a tempered update, a skeleton graph supplies frontiers and geodesic distances, and a two-stage terminator turns stop votes into termini through a trail-consistency gate and a budget-forced return. With every baseline re-run in one installation at one budget, the agent exceeds all four zero-shot baselines of the VLNVerse subset in mean success on both granularities, though the paired interval against the strongest coarse-grained baseline includes zero. Termination is the dominant lever in ablation, thirteen attempts to give the model more of the navigation establish no reliable gain, and the agent runs on a Unitree Go2 quadruped with off-board inference. Code, per-episode logs and a robot video will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/structure-over-reasoning-PAGE.
2610.25130.tldr_en: This work presents an agent that exceeds all four zero-shot baselines of the VLNVerse subset of the VLNVerse subset in mean success on both granularities, though the paired interval against the strongest coarse-grained baseline includes zero.

llm.title_ja: 推論より構造：小規模ビジョン・言語モデルを用いた統合型ゼロショットナビゲーション
llm.tldr_ja: 小規模VLMから得られる知覚的回答をアクションではなく証拠として扱い、鳥瞰図上の意味的フィールドやスケルトングラフ、2段階の終端装置と統合することで、全てのゼロショットベースラインを上回るナビゲーションエージェントを提案する。
llm.problem: ビジョン・言語ナビゲーションにおいて、小規模モデルは経路推論や距離推定、停止判断の能力にムラがあり、制御ループに直接組み込むことが難しい。
llm.method: モデルに毎ステップ2つの知覚的質問を行い、その回答を証拠として鳥瞰図上の意味的フィールド、スケルトングラフ、2段階終端装置を通じて処理するエージェントを構築した。
llm.result: VLNVerseサブセットの4つのゼロショットベースラインすべてを平均成功率で上回り、Unitree Go2四足歩行ロボット上でオフボード推論を用いて実行できることを実証した。
keywords_ja: ビジョン言語ナビゲーション

2610.25114.title: Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds
2610.25114.abstract: Embodied AI lacks the data-rich pretraining that gave language models their agents and skills, so new manipulation capability costs demonstrations per task or a frontier model in every episode. We study a third route: a strong general model acts only as an offline author that writes, runs, diagnoses and repairs a manipulation skill in simulation until it passes an exam on layouts drawn after freezing; the frozen skill then runs as code alone or under a cheap caller that reads only its description. We call this skill-level recursive self-improvement Skill-RSI and specify a compile protocol (isolated, audited author; hidden validation layouts; no-feedback and inherit-only controls; tamper-evident ledger) and a reuse protocol that runs the identical files with executors from another model family. On 7 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with cluttered tables, Claude Code compiled 4 tasks into 7 frozen skills, 5 from a first draft needing only qualification, at USD 4.29-8.22 of author cost each (USD 55 per skill counting the 13 failed campaigns). The other three tasks did not compile in 18 campaigns, including five with GPT-6 and a pre-registered 150-layout run: on the hardest task every campaign scored 78-95 of 100 but had 3-16 safety aborts, failing the gate of 95% success with zero aborts; a 100-episode exam bounds an abort rate only to 3.6%. On hidden layouts, repair that inherits the previous version beat from-scratch rewriting in 8 of 8 controlled campaigns (sign test p = 0.004); an inherit-only lineage attributes most of the gap to inheritance, with development feedback adding a little (3 of 3, p = 0.125). Write-once campaigns found no detectable first-draft effect of practice (minimum detectable effect 14 points). The frozen skills kept 148/150 successes on new layouts with no model and 147/150 with a DeepSeek-flash caller at USD 0.00028-0.00054 per episode; no direct-control baseline was run.

llm.title_ja: 一度コンパイルし、安価に実行：体現型エージェントのための凍結・ポータブルなスキルと、再帰的自己改善がもたらすもの
llm.tldr_ja: 強力な一般モデルをオフラインのオーサとしてのみ機能させ、シミュレーション内でマニピュレーションスキルを執筆・検証・修復して凍結することで、コード単体または安価な呼び出し元で実行可能にするスキルレベルの再帰的自己改善「Skill-RSI」を提案する。
llm.problem: 体現型AIには言語モデルのような豊富な事前学習データが不足しており、新しいマニピュレーション能力の獲得にはタスクごとのデモンストレーションや毎エピソードでのフロンティアモデルの利用が必要となる。
llm.method: 孤立・監査されたオーサ、隠された検証レイアウト、改ざん防止台帳を備えたコンパイルプロトコルと、別のモデルファミリーのエグゼキューターで同一ファイルを実行する再帰的自己改善（Skill-RSI）フレームワークを提案する。
llm.result: 7つのRoboTwin 2.0タスクにおいて、Claude Codeが4つのタスクを7つの凍結スキルにコンパイルし、新レイアウトでの150回の試行中148回成功を維持した。

2610.25068.title: Localization and Neural Splatting on the Edge: An FPGA Scene Memory for Robots
2610.25068.abstract: Resource-constrained robots and autonomous vehicles need scene memories that localize a camera and render nearby views without a desktop GPU. Scene-coordinate regression (SCR) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) fit because they avoid an SfM stage, but ACEsplat-style pipelines are GPU-centered, and moving them to an edge FPGA is hard because SCR is pose-sensitive and 3DGS rendering is irregular and capacity-sensitive. We present LENS, an edge scene-memory acceleration system on the AMD KR260 that brings an ACEsplat-style workload to a low-power FPGA/ARM platform. Rather than proposing a new scene model, LENS co-designs the two dominant kernels with the board data path: an INT16 SCR accelerator that preserves pose accuracy, and a bit-exact fixed-point ordered 3DGS renderer that rewrites alpha transmittance as a log-sum-exp recurrence and removes provably useless streamed Gaussians. All LENS latency, power, and quality results are board-measured. The SCR engine preserves DSAC* localization accuracy at 25.42 ms, the on-board renderer reaches 34.11 dB on Cambridge against ACEsplat's 33.20, novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K reaches 27.84 dB against 26.11, and all ten Wayspots scenes reach the ACEsplat rendering target. LENS wins performance per watt over a Jetson Orin NX on every deployment task, by 1.9x to 5.7x at about a quarter of the power, and is faster in absolute latency on localization and Wayspots rendering. On-device training reaches ACEsplat-level quality but not the GPU's time or energy, marking the remaining boundary for a future training accelerator.

llm.title_ja: エッジにおけるローカライゼーションとニューラルスプラッティング：ロボットのためのFPGAシーンメモリ
llm.tldr_ja: デスクトップGPUなしでカメラの局所化と近傍ビューのレンダリングを行うため、AMD KR260上の低電力FPGA/ARMプラットフォームにACEsplatスタイルのワークロードを実装したエッジシーンメモリ加速システム「LENS」を提案する。
llm.problem: リソースが制限されたロボットや自律走行車には、デスクトップGPUなしでカメラの自己位置推定と近傍ビューのレンダリングを行えるシーンメモリが必要であるが、既存手法はGPU中心でありエッジFPGAへの移行が困難である。
llm.method: ポーズ精度を保持するINT16シーン座標回帰（SCR）アクセラレータと、アルファ透過率を対数和exp漸化式に書き換えて不要なガウスを除去するビット正確な固定小数点順序付き3DGSレンダラをボードデータパスと共同設計した。
llm.result: Jetson Orin NXと比較して消費電力の約4分の1で1.9倍から5.7倍のワット当たり性能を達成し、ローカライゼーションやWayspotsレンダリングで絶対レイテンシの優位性を示した。
keywords_ja: ハードウェアアクセラレーション
